o.text: Borrowed from Russian парк (park), from French parc.
From Proto-Common Turkic *kāla- (“to pile up, to stack”). The fire-related sense developed from the sense "to heap up firewood".
Borrowed from Ottoman Turkish مِلِّیَّت (milliyyet). By surface analysis, millət (“nation”) + -iyyət.
